title: CyberSecurity IncidentNarrativeTriage

stats.done_summary: Completed Scenario 05c end-to-end. Generated reproducible preprocessing + quantitative summaries (counts by source_system, narrative length stats, keyword-category hit totals, and top unigrams/bigrams) via code/01_summarize.py with outputs in outputs/*.csv and outputs/summary_for_llm.json. Created 3 figures saved as PNGs under report/images/: fig_counts_by_source.png, fig_length_words_by_source.png, fig_keyword_hits_by_source.png. Called Google Generative AI Gemini API using model gemini-1.5-pro (code/03_call_gemini.py) and saved the full raw response to outputs/gemini_raw.json plus extracted text/JSON to outputs/gemini_extracted.*. Assembled publication-style writeup in report/report.md (also copied to incident_triage_report.md) including Methods, Results (tables + figures), Discussion, and Limitations.
